Forms.invalid: Check this field and try again.
Forms.unavailable: Could not load this page. Please try again.

Forms.differentStations: Choose a destination station different from the origin.

Forms.arrivalAfterDeparture: Choose an arrival time after departure.
Forms.departureDateRange: Choose a last date on or after the first date, within a total of 90 days.
Forms.email: Enter a valid email address, such as name@example.com.
Forms.selection: Choose a valid option from the list.
Forms.dateTime: Enter a valid Cairo date and time. Repeated or missing times during a clock change cannot be used.
Forms.wholeNumber: Enter a whole number using digits 0–9.
Forms.minValue: Enter a value of at least {value}.
Forms.maxValue: Enter a value no greater than {value}.
Forms.price: Enter a non-negative price using digits 0–9 and at most two decimal places.
Forms.priceRange: The price must not exceed EGP 21,474,836.47.
Forms.code: Start with an English letter; use only letters, numbers and underscores, up to 32 characters.
Forms.time: Enter a valid time in hours and minutes.
